item.title: Blood moon: Total lunar eclipse will be seen March 3
item.description: A blood-red moon will soon grace the skies for a total lunar eclipse — and there won't be another until late 2028.

item.title: Black History Month: QCA Black history children's book fair

item.title: Volunteer firefighter arrested after 700-acre fire in Lee County wildlife area
item.description: A volunteer firefighter is in custody in connection with a fire at a Lee County wildlife area that spread over 700 acres, a news release says.
